recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片以顆粒球系增生為主，可見前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞到桿狀與分葉核球；部分細胞偏大、核呈異常 C 形或環狀的巨大桿狀核，細胞質顆粒不均，另有核過度分葉，屬於骨髓造血異常（dysmyelopoiesis）的形態線索。
features: Cellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation
Promyelocytes/myelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules alongside cells with reduced, uneven granulation
Enlarged metamyelocytes and bands with abnormal C-shaped or ring-like nuclei (giant band forms)
Mature neutrophils with irregular or excessive nuclear lobation
Scattered erythroid precursors; no obvious increase in blasts in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field dominated by granulocytic precursors with full maturation from promyelocytes to segmented neutrophils. Several granulocytes show dysplastic-appearing features, including enlarged metamyelocytes and bands with abnormal C-shaped to ring-like nuclei, uneven or reduced cytoplasmic granulation, and irregular nuclear lobation in mature neutrophils. Erythroid precursors are scattered, and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are suggestive of dysmyelopoiesis; because similar changes occur with megaloblastic anemia, drugs, growth factors and infection, quantification (at least 10% of granulocytes) and clinical correlation are required before attributing them to a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Giant metamyelocytes and bands with hypersegmented neutrophils occur in B12/folate deficiency together with megaloblastic erythroid precursors and resolve with replacement.
MDS is supported by dysplasia in at least 10% of cells of a lineage, hypogranular pseudo-Pelger forms, cytopenias and clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.

ddx.dx: G-CSF effect or infection-related left shift
ddx.vs: Growth factor or infection shows left-shifted granulopoiesis with toxic granulation and Dohle bodies rather than hypogranulation and nuclear dysplasia.
